authority_mode: shadow only; Planning V1 remains production authority

stages.name: Authority Snapshot
stages.schema: immutable hashes plus bounded typed projections and ordered formal event identities
stages.validator: authority availability, hashes, revision/CAS and exact ordered coverage
stages.repair_unit: none; rebuild only on authority change
stages.escalation: authority mismatch -> Planning restart or fail-close

stages.name: Event Realization Units
input_authority: one formal event or bounded contiguous event packet
stages.schema: Runtime-owned identity/ordinal/dependencies plus model-owned title and narrative
stages.validator: closed schema, narrative minimum, exact ownership, Canon terms, no foreign event claim
stages.merge: sort by Runtime ordinal; reject gaps/duplicates
stages.escalation: dependency closure or event subtree after one no-progress patch

stages.name: Semantic Transition Units
stages.owner: HYBRID: model proposes exit effect; Runtime normalizes and validates
stages.schema: Runtime-owned actor/time/location/relationship dimension keys and model-proposed bounded state effect values
stages.validator: capability, knowledge, location, relationship and authority non-mutation
stages.repair_unit: one affected dimension or dependency closure

stages.name: Dependency and Temporal/Causal Closure
stages.owner: LOCAL_RUNTIME; conditional bounded adjudication is a later optional extension
stages.schema: typed predecessor/successor, precondition/effect and scene setup/payoff edges
stages.validator: DAG/order, precondition producers, no impossible state/knowledge/time jump

stages.name: Scene Execution Projection
stages.schema: segment/event/beat ownership, actionable narrative, entry/exit state and future-beat guard
stages.validator: Draft executability, exact coverage, adjacent handoff
stages.repair_unit: none directly; route finding to source artifact

stages.name: Deterministic Assembly
stages.schema: IDs, versions, ordering, hashes, PlanningDocumentIR/topology/manifest candidates
stages.validator: version/hash/CAS, referential integrity and byte-stable serialization
stages.freeze: candidate immutable for exact dependency set

stages.name: Global Semantic Closure
stages.owner: LOCAL_RUNTIME validators plus existing semantic-review boundary
stages.schema: per-invariant status, evidence hashes, Draft readiness, promotion eligibility
stages.validator: authority, references, time, causal, actor, knowledge, location, relationship, scene and completeness
consumers: shadow metrics; future promotion gate only after separate authorization
stages.merge: no merge; PASS or typed findings
stages.freeze: PASS receipt binds exact assembly hash

why_seven: READY already supplies core intent/order authority, so a new model-generated skeleton would duplicate authority. Seven stages isolate creative event realization and semantic transition decisions while keeping dependency closure, Draft projection and assembly local.
